page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Text centred in one column from top to bottom, with an engraving in the middle and the imprint at the foot. No margins with text.
page.notes: The scan is heavily bled through from the reverse, so the mirrored text of the other side is left out. The lines marked illegible are faint. The engraving in the middle of the page (a pictorial device with figures and a frame) is not transcribed. The imprint and date readings are uncertain and marked by the surrounding letters only where I could read them; the year line in particular may read differently. No running head, page number, catchword or signature is printed.
